brief.request: Passive three-way approaching the published performance of the reference, similar size, budget of parts about 1500 EUR per pair.
topology_constraints: single speaker-cable input with optional bi-amp links

objectives.name: sensitivity_db_2v83_1m
objectives.basis: Example target only; replace with a stated comparable sensitivity convention
objectives.reference_value: Fill only from a source with known voltage/power, distance, band, weighting and environment; do not assume the maker and independent figures are comparable.
objectives.class_note: 2.83 V is 1 W at 8 ohm and 2 W at 4 ohm, so this figure is only comparable at a stated impedance. Check it against lf_box efficiency.ceiling for this volume and cutoff before iteration 1

objectives.name: f6_hz
objectives.basis: Example system sustained -6 dB target relative to a declared system reference band; do not relabel a published -3 dB figure
objectives.class_note: bound to sensitivity and volume by the efficiency law; the three cannot be set independently

objectives.name: impedance_min_ohm
objectives.reference_value: fill from the reference's measured minimum, not from its nominal label
objectives.class_note: IEC 60268-5 allows 80 percent of nominal, and published measurements of comparable speakers often read lower. Every Zobel, notch and pad the level budget forces will move this

objectives.name: ripple_200_10000_db
objectives.class_note: published flatness figures across the measurement corpora span roughly +/-1 to +/-6 dB; see target-response.md section 9

objective_review.comment: Example only: replace priorities, targets and all reference claims from the actual brief and research. Record comparisons and conflicts without changing the user's targets.
conflicts: example: the sensitivity and extension targets sit within 1 dB of the lossless ceiling for the stated volume, and the impedance-minimum target is stricter than the reference product measures; expect the level budget to spend the difference in pad depth, parts and heat

limits.scope_note: Iteration/candidate counts budget detailed design work, not researched parts, catalogue coverage or inexpensive screening. Explicit user research/time limits take precedence.
